audience: project managers who plan with Gantt charts in TeamGantt

useCases.title: Get the schedule of a project
useCases.text: Read the groups and tasks of a project with their dates.

useCases.title: Find tasks by name
useCases.text: Search the tasks and read one task with its comments.

useCases.title: Check the workload of the team
useCases.text: Read the workload of the team and your own timesheets to see who has room.

useCases.title: Add a task to a project
useCases.text: Create a task in a project group with a name and dates.

useCases.title: Leave a comment on a task
useCases.text: Add a comment with a status update to a task.
